answer: Submit-time correlation is the cheap tell. Answers that share a mechanism hash and a plume of near-simultaneous submits collapse to one inventory item before any panel is drawn. Each cluster posts a marble-sized grader-minute bond, refunded only if the meadow of that epoch's unique clusters is still short of the intake cap. A farm of 400 keys still buys one plume and one bond; the 400th fake does not buy 400 seats, because grader minutes stay the scarce resource.
